subject: Post-call: data handling & training opt-out — Meridian Healthtech
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: data handling notes and next steps

Hi Sophie — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps so we have the same expectations: 

What we heard from Meridian:
- No model training or model improvements with Meridian customer data (including logs and transcripts).
- PII must be redacted before any data leaves your environment; where possible you will route only pseudonymized records.
- Retention: primary requirement is 90 days for request logs, with options for shorter retention for debug traces.
- Logging: you want access to request-level logs for audit but need controls to prevent the data being used for improvement.

What Redwood proposes (high level):
- Formal opt-out: Redwood will not use customer-provided content to train or improve models for Meridian.
- KV/prefix caching and inference telemetry will be available only for 90 days by default and can be reduced.
- We will provide a filtered audit log feed and an exported, redacted logs option for your security team.

Attachments: Data_Privacy_Summary.pdf (high-level controls) and a draft Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx that maps milestones (PO, security review, signed opt-out).

Proposed next steps:
1) Can you confirm the opt-out requirement in writing and share the legal contact to finalize language?
2) If accepted, we will prepare a one-page confirmation letter and a DocuSign for signatures.
3) Team kickoff once PO and signatures are complete — propose week of 10/26.

If anything above is incorrect or missing, flag and I will update.

Thanks,
Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Data_Privacy_Summary.pdf (2 pages)]
[Attachment: Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (stub)]

From: Sophie Grant <sophie@meridianhealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Edgar Miles <edgar.miles@meridianhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T09:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: data handling notes and next steps

Connor — thanks for the clear summary. This aligns with our security/ops expectations. Two quick asks before we proceed: 

1) We need a short, signed confirmation from Redwood explicitly stating that Meridian data will not be used for model training or improvement (including any derivative training).
2) Please confirm what logs Redwood retains by default (request logs, inference traces, system telemetry) and provide the retention window and an option to delete earlier than default.

Looping in Edgar from Legal to help finalize language. Once we have that confirmation and the MAP updated, we can move forward with procurement.

Best,
Sophie Grant
Head of Platform Operations, Meridian Healthtech

[Security contact: security@meridianhealth.com]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-10-16T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Draft wording for opt-out confirmation (internal)

Connor / Laura — suggested one-paragraph confirmation we can send to Sophie / Edgar. Use this as the body of the signed letter; Legal can add boilerplate.

-- DRAFT CONFIRMATION START --
Redwood Inference confirms that it will not use any customer-provided content, telemetry, or logs from Meridian Healthtech for model training, model fine-tuning, or algorithmic improvements. Redwood will segregate any operational telemetry used for platform reliability and will provide Meridian with the ability to set retention windows (default 90 days) and to request deletion of data earlier than the retention window. All audit logs shared with Meridian will be redacted to remove PII unless otherwise mutually agreed.
-- DRAFT CONFIRMATION END --

Also note: Legal will want to reference our standard data processing addendum (DPA) and include the DocuSign link. I recommend attaching the Data_Privacy_Summary.pdf and the short MAP when we reply.

Neha
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie@meridianhealth.com>, Edgar Miles <edgar.miles@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmation: training-on-customer-data opt-out + logging & retention controls

Hi Sophie & Edgar — per our call and the draft we discussed, please find Redwood's formal confirmation below. Attaching signed stub for your records and a DocuSign link to finalize.

Formal confirmation (for signature):
Redwood Inference confirms that it will not use any customer-provided content, telemetry, or logs from Meridian Healthtech for the purpose of model training, model fine-tuning, benchmarking, or algorithmic improvements to any Redwood models or services. This includes any direct traces, transcripts, or derived embeddings.

Logging & retention summary (controls available to Meridian):
- Default retention: 90 days for request/usage logs.
- Shorter retention: Meridian may request retention windows as low as 30 days; Redwood will implement per-customer retention policy on a contractual basis.
- Deletion: Redwood will provide an export and a guaranteed deletion workflow for customer-requested data removals; deletion requests will be completed within 7 business days of verification.
- Audit logs: Redwood can provide redacted audit feeds; PII will be redacted by default. If specific fields need to be preserved for troubleshooting, those will be handled under a separate agreement.

Attachments included: Redwood-Training-OptOut-Signature.pdf (signed confirmation stub), Data_Privacy_Summary.pdf, Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/rdw/confirm/RDW-1374
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/meridian-healthtech

Next steps:
- Edgar: please confirm if the wording above is sufficient or if Legal wants edits to the confirmation paragraph.
- Sophie: once confirmed, sign the DocuSign and we will lock in the kickoff week (proposed 10/26).
- Neha / Laura: prepare the implementation checklist and security packet for the kickoff.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if you'd prefer to run through legal language live.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood-Training-OptOut-Signature.pdf (stub)]
